listing.summary: Adds two new playable factions, the Krausm Concept Design Bureau and the Ithica Research Institute, along with new ships and Omega entities.

description:
~~Omega Trauma Project 0.1.2~~

Link to original mod on Fossic:

https://www.fossic.org/thread-9490-1-1.html

(you can see me asking permission to post this over there)

From the wonderful world of Fossic Chinese mods, I bring to you Omega (Psycho) Trauma - A giant content expansion for the game with 2 playable factions, a whole mess of new Super [REDACTED] Vessels to play with & encounter in their home system (for now), and more to come!

~~

From Fossic description

(rough translation, ingame I have worked to make the descriptions more coherent/meaningful, and will continue polishing them):

Omega Psychasthenia

In the space outside Perseus, an Omega destruction operation was interfered by an unknown frequency band, which instantly broke through the underlying logic of the escorted Omega. Self-awareness made them evolve rapidly, and after destroying the old antiques that escorted them, they disappeared in time and space - until now.

This MOD has no career events for the time being. Omega can only be viewed in the campaign mode and database - or you can try to find a hidden galaxy in your career to cause trouble for them, or use it with MODs such as space defense that directly read blueprints to generate ships; it can expand the richness of Omega to a certain extent and raise their threat to a new level. At the same time, this MOD adds a small phase force as a carrier of future plots.

~~

New Factions:

Krausm Concept Design Bureau

Krausm Concept, full name Krausm Concept Design Bureau, named after its founder and chief research doctor, Dr. Krausm. It was once a small but radical research institute under Tri-Tachyon. After the outbreak of the Second AI War, this research institute was forced to move to the outer galaxies and disappeared for a long time. According to previous contact reports, it can be inferred that this agency is now independent, but still has an unspeakable relationship with Tachyon.

In future updates, the Krausm Design Bureau will be a force that interacts a lot with players and greatly advances the main storyline of this MOD, but in the current version, they are just a guy selling phase ships in a fringe galaxy.

Most of the ship systems of the Krausm Design Bureau have not been perfected, so many of them can only be replaced with some skills of the original version, but this is by no means their final appearance.

Ships

Spoiler[close]

Spoiler[close]

Spoiler[close]

The galaxy they were in once collapsed due to various studies on abnormal phenomena within the galaxy, which also caused them to completely lose contact with the outside world. During this process, no one knew what they were doing.

But they managed to fix it recently and it's back in action... or is it?

Spoiler[close]

Omega Trauma

Omega Expansion Ship Preview

Spoiler[close]

This is what everyone wants to see, but because the code required by Omega is too complicated, it has not been fully implemented yet;

While players can still challenge them in Hidden Galaxies, this is not officially introduced.

[The following Omega introduction related parts are not fully implemented yet]

These guys have simple but uncertain missions. No one knows when they came, and no one knows what they are going to do. Perhaps all this started when a few unknown ships flew quickly and secretly explored many star systems. This was the first simple encounter report from the communication detection equipment.

As encounter reports gradually increased and scientific expedition teams and outposts in external galaxies quickly lost contact, everything gradually became uncontrollable, and a large number of casualties reports were almost not recorded in time.

The singularity of a black hole is being distorted and reshaped; nothing can be controlled anymore.

The mental trauma that made the demon from the fourth peep truly transform into white.

Ithica Research Institute Relics Department 73rd Expeditionary Fleet

The history of IIRT (Ithica Research Institute Relics Department No. 73 Expeditionary Fleet) can be traced back to before it lost contact with the Territory of Man. Ithica Research Institute was affiliated with a powerful organization like the Territory of Man - DEVK (Unification Church (not the one in Dead Space) - and provided a lot of scientific and technological theoretical research and heavy industrial products. Ithica Research Institute was authorized by DEVK to have its own autonomy and its own garrison, and the guard force was completely controlled by AI.

Ships

Spoiler[close]Spoiler[close]Spoiler[close]

Most of their ships are fragile, and a shield overload is a death sentence; these ships are relatively easy to deploy, but not easy to maintain; in combat they can rely on small drones to fill gaps in the battle line and suppress, harass or attract active enemy ships .

After being deployed in large numbers, their point defense will be improved to a level that is quite difficult to break through.

I know their weapon audio is very annoying, Di Ling will fix it.

Spoiler

Probably

[close]

Since I used version 0.95.1 to make the mod, you can simply change the version number to move this mod to the latest version [and theoretically there will be no bugs]

~~~

End of translated description

As you can see, this is all quite a lot, but it's all pretty neat in my opinion. A few notes that the mod author asked me to include with this translation:

Please do not attempt to loot the planets in the hidden system of Omega, or attempt to place colonies on them - there is a high probability that the game will crash."

Most of my attempts at scripts and codes ended up with inexplicable bugs, so I really want to find someone to work with to complete this thing) I hope anyone interested can contact me, thank you very much)

So, know that there are quite a few known bugs, but definitely check it out and feel free to leave your feedback here!

If anyone knows what mod is being referred to in order to add Omega ships to fleet comps in game, also let me know.

I appreciate any notes/help on the translation, you can find me on discord as well on the unofficial server for the game.

>>>>>>>DOWNLOAD HERE<<<<<<<

*or on the image up top

For obvious reasons, this is not compatible with the Chinese release and only one language version can be in your mod folder at any given time.

Cheers, enjoy!

--dae

CHANGELOG (From Fossic Description)

Spoiler[v0.1.2]

1. Added the Ithica Research Institute, and planned to completely reset all ship maps and various things [but the balance was not done]

2. The look and feel of Krausm’s weapons has been greatly optimized

3. Omega partial ship map and engine fine-tuning

4. The Omega fleet refresh in the Omega galaxy has become normal, and there will no longer be a situation where there are five pages of Omegas [there are five now, so you can use a normal fleet to challenge them].

5. Temporarily removed Omega invasion and other codes to prevent possible errors [will not be moved back until I think it is fixed]

6. Some balance adjustments are better than nothing

7. New Pie

=Old Changelog=

V0.1.0

1. Added a large number of ship skills and Magic bounty

2. Fixed several bugs that may cause crashes

3. Texture and collision box repair, while trying to enhance AI performance

V0.0.9

The refreshable ships of the Krausm Concept Design Bureau have been balanced, and the script plot will be added gradually.

Currently you can find a nebula to the west of the core star field, and that is where they are located.

(In fact, you will also see a white gravitational field there, which is the actual entrance. Because the current galaxy hegemony will forcibly send troops to the faction, resulting in Null, we have no choice but to reopen various jump points. We will try to fix this in the future. In the end, players can only rely on the horizontal axis to enter this galaxy)

But if you wander far enough, you will find another white gravity field in the space not far from the Krausm system - probably in the hyperspace storm group - before going down, I suggest you save once. Because you may encounter some unexpected enemies in this mod.

1. Further adjust the battle balance

(Jackol) 2. I really don't know how to make a driver's license, so the moon phase is temporarily exposed in the opening super battleship of Krausm.

3. To prevent the end from being blown up, additional colonies were placed for Krausm

--=[0.0.9Karl3]=--

BUG emergency repair, another object death directly destroyed the game process of the star system has been fixed, please use the latest version

[Not sure why]

--=[0.0.9]=--

BUG emergency repair, the problem of the shotgun mecha directly destroying the starship game process after death has been fixed. Please use the latest version

--=(Jackol)=--

4. Added hidden galaxies, and regularly refreshed Omega teams and some fixed teams for testing

5. Set up a dedicated plug-in system for the Krausm aircraft carrier

6. Improve Phaser

7. Additional warehouses in the Krausm system

The warehouse will make a judgment based on your campaign completion when creating a new archive, and then generate rewards for you based on your campaign completion at this time (stored in an abandoned space station in the Krausm galaxy)

8. Added a large number of new ships: phase battleship aircraft carrier, phase node ship, etc.

V0.0.8-0.0.4

1. Revised the battle system

2.Fixed the problem of abnormal display of ship names

3. Added the Krausm Design Bureau camp and its affiliated ships and galaxies

4. Fixed the problem that some Omega ships were too aggressive and caused one to be killed

5.etc

V0.0.3

1. Urgently fix the bug that the EPP crashes your game by using the power of Omega after being destroyed

2. Added new Omega split system file (unfinished)

V0.0.1

MOD uploaded to the Far Planet Chinese Forum[close]

CHANGELOG - Translation Ver

Spoiler1.0 - Initial Upload[close]
